title: A composition of flat ring maps is flat
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ and $\psi:S\to T$ be ring maps of commutative rings. If $\varphi$ and $\psi$ are flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $\psi\circ\varphi:R\to T$ is flat.
